body.statement: For arbitrary real interior observed summaries, \(\mathfrak T_0(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) admits on every compact finite-budget box \(\mathcal B\) a finite semialgebraic stratification, with defining formulas over the coefficient field \(K_{\mathrm{in}}\); its lower-dimensional strata contain all optimizer ties, legal-root collisions, constant-\(U\) contacts, and stationary continua.  The lower endpoint \(L\) is continuous and coordinatewise nonincreasing in \((\Gamma_A,\Gamma_0,\Gamma_1)\).  If the observed summaries and endpoints of \(\mathcal B\) are rational or real algebraic, \(\mathsf{ATLAS}\), separately from the fixed-input procedure \(\mathsf{CERT}\), terminates and returns exact quantifier-free sign cells on the complement of \(\mathfrak T_0\) and exact algebraic strata on the surface; rational isolating intervals are returned only after zero-dimensional specialization.
body.justification: The tipping surface converts three interpretable confounding budgets into the exact frontier at which a positive causal conclusion fails.
body.gap: Masten--Poirier study breakdown frontiers for other relaxations; the common-\(U\) frontier is multibudget, algebraic, and branch-switching.
body.consumer: Sensitivity reports can display which combinations of treatment and outcome associations, rather than one arbitrary scalar, overturn the sign conclusion.
